verdict.rationale: Capacities documents its own search as fast and offline-capable on all devices, tolerant of inexact wording, and able to find block content. However, the evidence never documents search filters on tags, properties, or paths, and does not explicitly confirm full-text indexing across all notes. Missing for 10: documented tag/property/path filtering in search, explicit full-text indexing of all note content, independent or hands-on corroboration of speed and offline behavior.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can instantly search all my notes with full-text search plus filters on tags, properties, and paths — including offline

citations.quote: It works offline on all devices, giving you quick search results every time.
Search in Capacities is designed to return useful results even when your wording is not exact.
